description: Humanitarian situation reports, needs assessments, appeals, analyses and press releases published on ReliefWeb by ~4,000 UN agencies, NGOs, governments and research bodies. AUTHORITATIVE for "what do humanitarian responders say is happening in <country or crisis>" — this is UN OCHA's own corpus, not news coverage of it. Filter by country, disaster, disaster type, publishing organisation, theme, document format and publication date, or free-text search the title and body. Returns title, publishing source, primary country, disaster, format, publication date and the ReliefWeb URL. Requires a caller-supplied ReliefWeb appname in _apiKey.

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Sudan" or "SDN".

format.description: Document format, e.g. "Situation Report", "Assessment", "Appeal", "Analysis", "News and Press Release", "Map".

from_date.description: Only reports published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-08-01".

include_body.description: Include a text excerpt of each report body (default false — bodies are long and most callers want the list first).

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging (default 0).

query.description: Free-text search over title and body, e.g. "cholera outbreak", "cash assistance".

source.description: Publishing organisation name or shortname, e.g. "OCHA", "WFP", "UNHCR".

theme.description: Humanitarian theme, e.g. "Food and Nutrition", "Health", "Protection and Human Rights", "Shelter and Non-Food Items".

to_date.description: Only reports published on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: reliefweb_reports
title: Reliefweb Reports
